A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we developed a new model which can be used for studying PCS network performance, and the model can be applied to a wide range of PCS network environments.

we have developed a model for the PCS network in which the total call arrival is a MAP and the call holding times are PH distributions; we have obtained the distribution of the actual holding times of the new calls and the handoff calls, and the distributions of the blocking durations of new calls and handoff calls, respectively.
we have developed the Markov model for describing the homogeneous PCS network with MAP call arrivals and PH cell residence time, and we have found the complexity of the Markov process.
The main takeaway from our work is that
we can model the arrival process by a MAP, and the channel holding times by a PH distribution; and the cell residence time by a PH distribution.
the Markov arrival process and PH distributions provide a powerful framework for the analysis of a wide range of PCS networks.
the PCS network with the Markov call arrival process and the PH cell residence time is more general than the one studied by many other researchers.
